question: Doesn’t wrath react to Subaru’s scent? I’m sure Petelgeuse was saying he was jealous or something.
answer: Not really? Petelgeuse was mistaken about wrath. (Note: In this question, and often in others, Petelgeuse was written ‘ペテ公’ (pete-kou) and I’m not sure how to translate it, so I just went with Petelgeuse. Prince Pete, Lord Pete, or something similar might have been more accurate.)
